# Scenario: invalid proxy.target.url combinations soft-fail validation and leave
# prior compose/proxy state alone (url+inbound.port; url XOR service; url with path).

cd git-repo
exec git init -b main
exec git config user.email 'test@apinfra.local'
exec git config user.name 'Test Agent'
exec git add .
exec git commit -m 'feat: valid compose proxy baseline'
cd ..

cp .apinfra.template .apinfra
exec sh -c 'echo "repo=file://'$WORK'/git-repo" >> .apinfra'

exec apinfra
stderr 'done duration='
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-web-web-1
exists $HOME/infra/nginx/conf/dev_e2e-web.conf
grep 'web\.apinfra_e2e-web' $HOME/infra/nginx/conf/dev_e2e-web.conf

# url is only allowed with inbound.domain-name (not inbound.port)
cd git-repo
cp ../settings.url-with-port.yml dev/settings.yml
exec git add dev/settings.yml
exec git commit -m 'fix: url with inbound.port'
cd ..

exec apinfra
stderr 'WARN cycle finished with errors'
stderr 'invalid settings.yml format'
stderr 'only allowed with proxy\.inbound\.domain-name'
stderr 'done duration='
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-web-web-1
exists $HOME/infra/nginx/conf/dev_e2e-web.conf
grep 'web\.apinfra_e2e-web' $HOME/infra/nginx/conf/dev_e2e-web.conf

# url XOR proxy.target.service
cd git-repo
cp ../settings.url-with-service.yml dev/settings.yml
exec git add dev/settings.yml
exec git commit -m 'fix: url with target.service'
cd ..

exec apinfra
stderr 'WARN cycle finished with errors'
stderr 'invalid settings.yml format'
stderr 'proxy\.target\.url and proxy\.target\.service are mutually exclusive'
stderr 'done duration='
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-web-web-1
exists $HOME/infra/nginx/conf/dev_e2e-web.conf
grep 'web\.apinfra_e2e-web' $HOME/infra/nginx/conf/dev_e2e-web.conf

# url must be scheme://host[:port] only (path rejected)
cd git-repo
cp ../settings.url-with-path.yml dev/settings.yml
exec git add dev/settings.yml
exec git commit -m 'fix: url with path'
cd ..

exec apinfra
stderr 'WARN cycle finished with errors'
stderr 'invalid settings.yml format'
stderr 'must not include a path'
stderr 'done duration='
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-web-web-1
exists $HOME/infra/nginx/conf/dev_e2e-web.conf
grep 'web\.apinfra_e2e-web' $HOME/infra/nginx/conf/dev_e2e-web.conf

-- .apinfra.template --
namespace=dev
repoBranch=main

-- git-repo/dev/settings.yml --
version: "1.0"
projects:
  - name: e2e-web
    enabled: true
    proxy:
      inbound:
        port: 9999
      target:
        service:
          name: web
          port: 80
    config:
      cert-issue-type: none

-- settings.url-with-port.yml --
version: "1.0"
projects:
  - name: e2e-web
    enabled: true
    proxy:
      inbound:
        port: 9999
      target:
        url: https://api.example.org
    config:
      cert-issue-type: none

-- settings.url-with-service.yml --
version: "1.0"
projects:
  - name: e2e-web
    enabled: true
    proxy:
      inbound:
        domain-name: e2e-edge.apinfra.test
      target:
        url: https://api.example.org
        service:
          name: web
          port: 80
    config:
      cert-issue-type: none

-- settings.url-with-path.yml --
version: "1.0"
projects:
  - name: e2e-web
    enabled: true
    proxy:
      inbound:
        domain-name: e2e-edge.apinfra.test
      target:
        url: https://api.example.org/v1
    config:
      cert-issue-type: none

-- git-repo/dev/e2e-web/docker-compose.yml --
services:
  web:
    image: hashicorp/http-echo:latest
    command: ["-listen=:80", "-text=OK"]

-- .env --
